parts.t: Kitsilano — or "Kits" to locals — is one of Vancouver's most beloved communities, where beach culture meets urban sophistication. With Kitsilano Beach, the outdoor pool, boutique shopping on 4th Avenue, and stunning mountain and ocean views, it's a neighbourhood that embodies the Vancouver lifestyle at its finest.
